children: falls 9.5% pre-market Tuesday following a Bloomberg report that shareholder Kayne Anderson is offering shares in the company for $11.60-$11.90 each in an unregistered block trade, with Morgan Stanley reportedly serving as the sole book-running manager.
Kayne Anderson's offering of 8M shares of Mach Natural Resources
would be marketed at as much as a 7.1% discount to Monday’s $12.49 closing price.
The offering comes as Mach Natural Resources
is coping with high debt levels and heavy exposure to weak natural gas prices.
